description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipService interface, which specifies methods for managing product relationships, groups, and related operations within a product catalog system.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipService
classes.description: A service interface for handling product relationship operations, including creation, retrieval, grouping, and status management.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new ProductRelationship or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductRelationships filtered by store, product, type, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all ProductRelationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all product relationship groups for a specific store.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product relationship group within a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves product relationships belonging to a specific group, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified product relationship group.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates a specified product relationship group.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates a specified product relationship group.
